zh-CN.title: 会话列表传输优化
items: 减少会话列表中重复传输的成员资料，保留未读、艾特与群聊信息
会话列表支持 HTTP 压缩，按压缩后大小选择更省流量的格式

en.title: Leaner chat list transfers
items: Chat lists transfer less repeated member data while preserving unread counts, mentions and group details
Chat lists support HTTP compression and select the smaller compressed representation
